The dominant macro backdrop is ai/tech headlines but the tradeable HK tech themes sit at the bottom of the rank table and are ineligible (Hurst mean-revert/mixed, negative scores), so the detector's only validated edge — the trend gate — says the money is NOT in tech here. No scorable ETF proxy exists for the leading themes; the two scorable themes (China Tech and Megacaps) are ineligible, so any call is inherently low-accountability.
